label: preparing
what: A coordinated local baking and hospitality presentation in the great hall on day 1 at 18:00, organized by the innkeeper with local tradespeople, likely including the baker. Bread deliveries to the inn and the innkeeper's bread sack support practical preparation. The secretary knowingly helps schedule it. Its existence has now been disclosed to me, but its full arrangements and other participants remain unknown; builder and freight involvement is not established.
